summary: Role tokens (owner decision C173, 2026-11-14, refining C156): a few named values above the scales, each an alias of an existing step, easier for people and AI to pick than a bare step and changed at once in one place. Names follow --sf-<area>--<role>, the form of --sf-radius--ui. A role is a reference, never a number of its own, so the width ladder and the compact density move it by themselves; because a custom property resolves where it is declared, the step-dependent roles are declared again in every scope that redefines the steps (the density regions, written by scripts/generate-density.mjs from this list's SCSS), or they would freeze on the root's step (RT-15). Heights, icon sizes, shadows, motion and focus do not become role names (C173 point 8): the source check guards their raw values instead. The five layer roles (point 7; names and order by owner decision C181 (3), 2026-11-14) replace the numbered z-index steps in components: base < sticky < popover < window <= message, each reading a step of the existing scale; above the page the layer stack (core/js/layer-stack.js) orders windows and messages by opening. The numbered steps --sf-z-index--1 ... 9 stay declared as aliases until 2027-01-01. The owner raised the cap from 17 to 18 on 2026-11-14 (13 names + 5 layers). The C105 line «no new variable names» is replaced by this decision.

tokens.name: --sf-gap--actions
tokens.role: Buttons of one group: a dialog or window footer, a confirmation, a wizard footer, a page header's actions, a notice's buttons (C105 H5, C144, C156).

tokens.name: --sf-gap--toolbar
tokens.role: Icon buttons inside one toolbar group and the margins of a toolbar separator (C144).

tokens.name: --sf-gap--tags
tokens.role: Tags and chips side by side, in a field or a row (C105 H5, C58, C145).

tokens.name: --sf-gap--groups
tokens.role: Between groups and between cells (C105 H6).

tokens.name: --sf-gap--icon-text
tokens.role: A picture (icon, avatar, check) to the text of a row: list, menu, choice, field, notice, cell (C105 H2).

tokens.name: --sf-gap--icon-inline
tokens.role: An icon inside running text: a breadcrumb, a link (C105 H3).

tokens.name: --sf-inset--panel
tokens.role: The padding of a card, a window, a drawer, a notice: the frame is part of it (C105 H6).

tokens.name: --sf-inset--plate
tokens.role: The underlay of a popup panel or a scroll area around its row plates (C105, C106).

tokens.name: --sf-radius--inner
tokens.role: The corner of a part inside a host: the host's corner minus the inset between them, never below 4 (C77, C145, C173 point 5). The root value is for a surface host with a plate underlay; a host with another corner or inset declares the same formula on itself, because a formula resolves where it is declared.

tokens.name: --sf-line--indicator
tokens.role: An indicator line: the chosen tab's line, a chosen frame (C99).

tokens.name: --sf-hit--min
tokens.role: The smallest press area (C76, C58; WCAG 2.5.8).

tokens.name: --sf-hit--touch
tokens.role: The press area on a touch screen (C49).

tokens.name: --sf-layer--base
tokens.role: The page itself and what lies flat in it (C181 (3)).

tokens.name: --sf-layer--sticky
tokens.role: Parts that stay on screen while the page scrolls under them: a site header, sticky tabs, a table of contents, a table's floating action band, a pane splitter (C181 (3)).

tokens.name: --sf-layer--popover
tokens.role: A panel that drops from its trigger over the page: a list at a field, a menu, a calendar, a colour panel, a popover's surface out of the top layer, an active editor block (C181 (3)).

tokens.name: --sf-layer--window
tokens.role: What covers the page: a window, a drawer, a bottom sheet with its veil, the loading screen; the base of the layer stack, which raises each open layer by its place (C181 (3)).

tokens.name: --sf-layer--message
tokens.role: A tooltip, a value bubble, a copy status, the notification area: over the rest around it, from the base of the layer stack, which orders it with windows by opening (C181 (3)).

classes.name: sf-actions
classes.role: A row of buttons of one group: flex, wrapping, centred, gap --sf-gap--actions (C173 point 3).

classes.name: sf-actions--end
classes.role: The same row pushed to the end.

rules: RT-NAMES: every role token is declared once on :root in the role SCSS with this list's value, no other --sf-<area>--<role> name of these areas is declared anywhere, and this list stays within the cap (18: 13 names and 5 layers, owner 2026-11-14).
RT-SCOPES: every role token marked density is declared again in both density regions (RT-15).

RT-ROLE-STEP: a gap of a button row, a toolbar or a row of tags in a component or Smart sheet uses its role token, never a space step, an atom or a length; known departures are listed in the baseline with their defect and fail once they are fixed (the entry must then be removed).
RT-SCRIM: a scrim reads --sf-scrim-color, never a palette black (RT-12).

RT-LAYERS: the five layer roles keep their order (base < sticky < popover < window <= message, C181 (3)) and each reads a step of the z-index scale (src/utility/z-index/default/scss/_sf_var__z_index.scss) whose value the contract records; a stacking number beyond the local -1..2 in the sources is the raw-value lint's (tools/lint-raw-values.mjs, C178), with no waiver left.
